description: One statistical series this platform mirrors from a publisher (the KAPSARC energy data portal, JODI, IRENA, the IMF, the IEA, the World Bank, Our World in Data, the CFTC, Climate TRACE, UN Comtrade), with its publisher, unit, licence, period range, a summary over the window (latest value per category, minimum, maximum, first-to-last change) and its newest points. Narrow the window with from and to, written as YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. Series ids come from list_datasets.
name: get_series
title: One mirrored statistical series
